nodes.name: Supervised classification
nodes.description: Learning a mapping from labelled features to classes, and judging it on unseen data.

nodes.name: Decision trees
nodes.description: A rule-based classifier learned from data; the first concrete model in the lab.

nodes.name: Overfitting and generalization
nodes.description: Why training accuracy overstates quality and how the train/test gap shows it.

nodes.name: Neural binary classifier
nodes.description: Weights, bias, logits, sigmoid, loss and gradient descent in a small PyTorch model.

nodes.name: Train/test split and decision thresholds
nodes.description: Precision, recall, F1 and how the threshold moves the trade-off.

nodes.name: Convolution and feature maps
nodes.description: A kernel slid over an image produces a feature map; manual kernels first.

nodes.name: Learned filters: shape CNN
nodes.description: A small CNN learns its own filters on synthetic shape images.

nodes.name: MNIST data and DataLoader
nodes.description: Image dataset loading, tensors and mini-batches.

nodes.name: Multiclass CNN and error analysis
nodes.description: Multiclass CNN training, held-out evaluation and looking at the mistakes.

nodes.name: Tokenization and token IDs
nodes.description: Text to vocabulary to IDs and back (character level).

nodes.name: Token embeddings
nodes.description: Learned vectors for token IDs.

nodes.name: Positional embeddings
nodes.description: Injecting order information into token representations.

nodes.name: Self-attention (Q, K, V)
nodes.description: Queries, keys and values compute weighted mixtures of token representations.

nodes.name: Causal self-attention
nodes.description: Masking future positions so each token only sees the past.

nodes.name: Multi-head attention
nodes.description: Several attention heads in parallel over split representations.

nodes.name: Attention output projection and residual
nodes.description: Projecting head outputs and adding the residual connection.

nodes.name: Layer normalization
nodes.description: Normalizing activations per token.

nodes.name: Feed-forward network
nodes.description: The position-wise MLP inside a Transformer block.

nodes.name: Transformer block
nodes.description: Attention + FFN + residuals + normalization combined.

nodes.name: Stacked Transformer blocks
nodes.description: Depth: repeating the block.

nodes.name: Language-model head and logits
nodes.description: Projecting hidden states to vocabulary logits.

nodes.name: Softmax and next-token probabilities
nodes.description: Turning logits into a probability distribution over the vocabulary.

nodes.name: Shifted targets and cross-entropy
nodes.description: Next-token targets and the training loss.

nodes.name: Backpropagation and gradients
nodes.description: Inspecting gradients that flow back through the model.

nodes.name: Optimizer update
nodes.description: Verifying how an optimizer step changes parameters.

nodes.name: Language-model training loop
nodes.description: Full loop on a tiny sequence; shows optimization and memorization, not language understanding.

nodes.name: Autoregressive generation and sampling
nodes.description: Greedy decoding, temperature and sampling. Roadmap Experiment 30 (NEXT); no exercise exists yet.

nodes.name: Local model inference
nodes.description: Loading and running pretrained models locally (Phase 05); no material yet.

nodes.name: Runtimes: Ollama & llama.cpp
nodes.description: Local model servers, GGUF and native inference (Phase 05); no material yet.

nodes.name: Hardware, quantization & benchmarking
nodes.description: RAM / VRAM, quantization, latency and tokens per second (Phase 05); no material yet.

nodes.name: Python ↔ local LLM
nodes.description: Calling a local model from Python with chat messages and streaming (Phase 06); no material yet.

nodes.name: Structured outputs
nodes.description: JSON Schema and validated responses; handling malformed ones (Phase 06); no material yet.

nodes.name: Timeouts, retries & errors at the model boundary
nodes.description: Bounded retries, timeouts and failure handling for model calls (Phase 06); no material yet.

nodes.name: Tool calling foundations
nodes.description: A model requests a structured call; the host validates, authorizes and executes it (Phase 06); no material yet.

nodes.name: Business-process decomposition
nodes.description: Map a workflow, separate deterministic from semantic steps and decide whether AI is appropriate (Phase 07).

nodes.name: Deterministic workflows & rules
nodes.description: Predictable, testable rule-based automation as the baseline for any AI step (Phase 07).

nodes.name: HTTP, REST, JSON & webhooks
nodes.description: Calling and receiving interfaces, data transformation and authentication concepts (Phase 07).

nodes.name: Validation, retries & idempotency
nodes.description: Input validation, timeouts, retries, idempotency and error handling in workflows (Phase 07).

nodes.name: Human approval & auditability
nodes.description: Where a person must approve, and how decisions are logged (Phase 07).

nodes.name: n8n fundamentals (local)
nodes.description: Workflow automation platform, self-hosted; it does not replace the fundamentals above (Phase 07).

nodes.name: Rules vs LLM vs RAG vs agent
nodes.description: Choose the simplest architecture that solves the problem; an agent is never the default (Phase 07).

nodes.name: Embedding models for retrieval
nodes.description: External sentence / document embedding models, distinct from internal token embeddings (Phase 08).

nodes.name: Cosine similarity & semantic search
nodes.description: Vector similarity and nearest-neighbor ranking (Phase 08).

nodes.name: Chunking, metadata & local indexes
nodes.description: Splitting documents, metadata and local indexes such as FAISS (Phase 08).

nodes.name: Retrieval evaluation & reranking
nodes.description: Measuring whether the right evidence is retrieved (Phase 08).

nodes.name: RAG pipeline
nodes.description: Ingestion, retrieval and context construction for grounded generation (Phase 09).

nodes.name: Citations, abstention & grounding
nodes.description: Answering only from evidence, citing it and abstaining when it is missing (Phase 09).

nodes.name: RAG evaluation & failure modes
nodes.description: Evaluate retrieval and generation separately; analyze failures (Phase 09).

nodes.name: Hybrid retrieval & query rewriting
nodes.description: Compare improvements against a baseline that exposed a concrete failure (Phase 09).

nodes.name: Validated tool execution
nodes.description: Argument validation, authorization and execution boundaries (Phase 10).

nodes.name: Agent loop from scratch
nodes.description: State, actions, observations, termination and budgets (Phase 10).

nodes.name: State, memory & context engineering
nodes.description: What survives between steps and runs (Phase 10).

nodes.name: Permissions, sandboxing & approval
nodes.description: Allowlists, path restrictions, sandboxes and human approval (Phase 10).

nodes.name: Minimal coding-agent experiment
nodes.description: Tiny controlled repository with read_file, write_file and run_tests (Phase 10).

nodes.name: Agent evaluation
nodes.description: Success, errors, cost and denied actions measured against a baseline (Phase 10).

nodes.name: MCP architecture
nodes.description: Client / server model, tools, resources, prompts and transports (Phase 11).

nodes.name: Local MCP server & safe tools
nodes.description: Minimal server exposing one or two safe tools (Phase 11).

nodes.name: MCP security boundaries
nodes.description: Permissions, tool discovery and trust boundaries (Phase 11).

nodes.name: LangChain
nodes.description: Framework for application composition, after the from-scratch loop and pipeline (Phase 12).

nodes.name: LangGraph & state graphs
nodes.description: Stateful, durable workflows and agents (Phase 12).

nodes.name: n8n AI workflows
nodes.description: AI steps, tools and agents inside n8n workflows (Phase 12).

nodes.name: Subagents & orchestration
nodes.description: Handoffs, routers and multi-agent patterns, compared with a single-agent baseline (Phase 12).

nodes.name: Agentic RAG & workflow vs agent
nodes.description: Compare agentic RAG and plain workflows on the same task (Phase 12).

nodes.name: Multimodal AI & voice
nodes.description: Vision-language models, audio, speech and voice systems (Phase 13).

nodes.name: Fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA & PEFT
nodes.description: Model adaptation compared against an unchanged baseline (Phase 14).

nodes.name: AI backend & client integration
nodes.description: Inference services, streaming, cancellation and clients (Phases 15–16).

nodes.name: Production AI, MLOps & LLMOps
nodes.description: Reliability, monitoring, regression testing and offline deployment (Phase 17).

nodes.name: Problem framing & build-vs-buy
nodes.description: Requirements, process mapping, cost awareness and local-vs-hosted reasoning.

nodes.name: Evaluation: baseline, success & failure modes
nodes.description: Baseline, success criteria, generalization, AI vs deterministic logic, model-failure behavior.

nodes.description: Prompt injection, untrusted data, tool permissions, secrets and privacy.

nodes.name: Observability & logging
nodes.description: Logging, tracing and monitoring of AI workflows.
